reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Jason Droege, a venture partner at Benchmark.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Jason Droege, a venture partner at Benchmark. Jason’s had a long entrepreneurial career, which most recently culminated in building and leading Uber Eats. He joined Uber in 2014 with a blank piece of paper to grow the business beyond ride sharing.

key_points.text: Within six years, he found product market fit with food delivery, refined the service.
Our conversation pulls out the most important lessons learned during that period and how Jason now employs them in his role at Benchmark.
Please enjoy this great conversation with Jason Droege.
